overall_rationale: To understand sales trends, we will analyze sales performance over time, identify top-selling products, and examine sales distribution across different regions. This will involve calculating key performance indicators (KPIs) such as total sales, average order value, and sales growth rate. We will also perform data quality checks to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the analysis.

kpis.name: Average Order Value
kpis.why: Indicates the average revenue per order.

kpis.name: Sales Growth Rate
kpis.formula: (Current Period Sales - Previous Period Sales) / Previous Period Sales
kpis.why: Shows the percentage change in sales over time.

analyses.name: Time Series Analysis
analyses.question: What are the sales trends over time?
analyses.method: Aggregate sales data by month and year to identify patterns and seasonality.
analyses.expected_insights: Identification of peak sales periods, growth trends, and potential seasonality.

analyses.name: Product Performance Analysis
analyses.question: Which products are the top sellers?
analyses.method: Calculate sales by product line to identify best-performing products.
analyses.expected_insights: Identification of top-selling product lines and their contribution to overall sales.

analyses.name: Geographical Sales Analysis
analyses.question: Where are the sales concentrated geographically?
analyses.method: Aggregate sales data by country to identify key markets.
analyses.expected_insights: Identification of top-performing countries and regional sales variations.

visualizations.title: Monthly Sales Trend
visualizations.purpose: Illustrates the change in sales over time.
visualizations.why: Helps identify seasonality and trends in sales.

columns_used.name: MONTH_ID

columns_used.description: The total sales amount for the specific product line in the order.
